rows.title: 🌅 Thank God for His Mercy, Grace & Blessings 🙏 | Powerful Morning Prayer to Start Your Day
rows.opening_transcript: Heavenly Father, I come before You this morning with a heart overflowing with gratitude. Thank You for Your mercy that is new every morning, Your grace that sustains me and Your blessings that surround me. Thank You for the gift of life, for the breath in my lungs, for the strength in my body and for the clarity in my mind. Thank You for waking me up to see another sunrise, another opportunity to walk in your purpose, and another chance to draw closer to you. Lord, your word declares in Lamentations 3.
